finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now takes either. [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags unset. It now reads unset as off. [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)

The 8 remaining warnings are real deprecations. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one to fix next.
